ITA-9.2.19 tailadhārā तैलधारा
Controlled pouring of oil over body
A procedure in which oil is made to poured in a stream (dhara) all over the body.

ITA-9.6.86 tailapāyanā तैलपायना
Tempering of sharp surgical instruments with oil
The tempering of surgical instruments in medicated oil.

.5 tailamūrcchanam तैलमूर्छनम्
Pre-processing of oil
Refining and enhancing the potency of ghee.

ITA-3.5.3 taila-vartikā तैलवर्तिका
Omentum
The truncal cavity between the chest and pelvis. It may also refer to the uterine cavity.

ITA-5.74.11 tailasevana-atiyogaḥ तैलसेवन-अतियोगः
Disorder due to excessive intake of oil, e.g. sesame oil
